wireRequirements.assertion: The maintained public template inventory is represented by explicit contained cases.
Each defined public navigation emits exactly one page_view to its intended stream.
Visible phone and WhatsApp controls emit their exact canonical event once per interaction.
GTM and direct measurement ownership do not double-dispatch canonical events; exact exclusions remain enforced.
Typed standard campaign and click identifiers survive the defined service, centre and enquiry journey.
One matching durable accepted receipt permits one enquiry_accepted payload and no premature event.
Rejected, unknown, mismatched, retried and refreshed attempts do not manufacture or duplicate accepted events.
Serialized measurement excludes personal/clinical fields and unapproved URL values in every defined case.
CHEQ starts only in its approved public scope and remains independent of the ClickGuard result.
ClickGuard supports the published centre-selected journey and the defined bridge exactly once on ordinary public query URLs without inventory gates.

externalRequirements.assertion: A dated native CHEQ receipt is correlated with an authorized genuine eligible visit.
A dated native ClickGuard receipt/application acknowledgement is correlated with the authorized visit.
The intended GA4 property/stream receives the authorized genuine interaction or accepted enquiry.
The exact enabled imported conversion is reconciled with its accepted genuine event and attribution scope.
A genuine committed enquiry, its durable receipt and source evidence are reconciled in the protected receiving system.
An authorized staff owner can open the protected lead link and acknowledges the real receiving result.
The explicitly required physical iPhone/iPad/SE session is identified and has actual device evidence; desktop WebKit is not substituted.
